description_en: Queries the back-to-origin CIDR blocks of Anti-DDoS Proxy
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-back-source-cidr --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --line coop-line-001 --ip-version IPv4 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBackSourceCidr

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The Internet service provider (ISP) line that you want to query
parameters.name: line

parameters.help_en:
The IP version of the back-to-origin CIDR blocks.

Ipv4
Ipv6
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的回源IP网段的IP协议类型。

Ipv4：表示IPv4协议。
Ipv6：表示IPv6协议
parameters.name: ip_version

Cidrs.description_en: An array that consists of the back-to-origin CIDR blocks of the instance

items.description_en: The back-to-origin CIDR block of the instance

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
